patthana11.7:1.1: Nakusalaṃ nadassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nakusalaṃ nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….

patthana11.7:11.1: Nakusalaṃ namahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nakusalaṃ naappamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
